briefing: Markets were neutral today with NASDAQ -0.6% and S&P 500 -0.5% — no clear risk-on signal despite three high-scoring candidates (CHYM, TNGX, MKC-V) showing full bullish confirmation. Per past lessons, we held cash rather than forcing new buys on a neutral day, and kept all seven existing positions intact.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Patience in investing means resisting the urge to deploy cash just because it's sitting idle, especially when the broader market isn't confirming a clear uptrend. Even with strong individual stock signals available, waiting for a genuine risk-on environment before committing new capital can help avoid buying into false starts.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 投資中的「耐性」是指即使手頭現金閒置，也不會因此而急於進場，尤其是在大市未能確認明確上升趨勢的情況下。即使個別股份出現強勁訊號，等待真正的風險偏好（risk-on）環境才投入新資金，有助避免買在假突破之中。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted slightly lower today, with NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.5%, reflecting a lack of strong directional conviction from investors. No major catalyst pushed markets sharply in either direction, so trading stayed range-bound and cautious. Individual names like CHYM, TNGX, and MKC-V still showed strong bullish technical setups, but that strength was stock-specific rather than market-wide.
market_education.summary_zh: 大市今日輕微回落，納斯達克指數下跌0.6%，標普500指數下跌0.5%，反映投資者缺乏明確方向性信心。今日並無重大消息推動市場大幅波動，交投維持窄幅整固格局。個別股份如CHYM、TNGX及MKC-V仍展現強勁的技術買入訊號，但這屬於個股層面的強勢，並非全市場性的上升趨勢。
